arrive.text: A cave. All your life, you've faced this wall.

shadows.text: Shapes pass by. The others name them, and guess what comes next.

turn.text: Behind you, a fire. People carrying cutouts. The shadows were only this.

climb.text: A path leads up, towards a light.

bright.text: It's too bright to look at.

choose.text: You could stay up here. Or go back down, and tell them.

back_dark.text: Down here, you can barely see anymore.

tell.text: They laugh. The climb has ruined your eyes, they say. Nobody else will go.

stay_end.text: You stay in the light. The others are still down there, and you're the only one who knows the way.

watch_end.text: You turn back to the wall. The shapes are familiar. It's easier.

reflection.text: Your reflection. Another kind of shadow, but this one looks back.

behind.text: The firelight flickers. Among the shapes on the wall, a new one. It moves when you move.

hurts.text: It hurts to look. The wall was easier.

outside_1.text: Outside. It's too bright. You can't make anything out yet.

outside_2.text: The real things. And the sun that lights them all.

horse.text: It's much bigger than its shadow.
